# Dirk Riehle's Industry and Research Publications

> > A comprehensive resource on open source software, inner source strategy, and product development from a leading computer science researcher and industry expert.

Dirk Riehle is a computer science professor with 15 years of industry experience at SAP and ETH Zurich, publishing extensively on open source licensing, free software principles, and commercial open source business models. This site serves as both an academic publication archive and practical guide to open source software engineering and compliance.

## Key Topics

- Open-source software
- Free and open-source software (FOSS)
- Open-source licenses
- Copyleft obligation
- License compliance
- Intellectual property rights
- Commercial open source
- Inner source
- Product strategy
- Software licensing
- Open Source Initiative (OSI)
- Free Software Foundation
- Software freedoms
- Open source definition

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://dirkriehle.com): Homepage showcasing Dirk Riehle's publications on open source, inner source, and product strategy
- [About](https://dirkriehle.com/about): Author biography: computer science professor with 15 years industry experience at SAP and ETH Zurich
- [Publications](https://dirkriehle.com/publications): Comprehensive list of academic publications on software engineering and open source

## Open-Source Software Fundamentals

- [Open-source software](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software): Guide to open-source software engineering, licensing, and supply chain security
- [Free and open-source software](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open): Educational content on free software history, licenses, and copyleft principles
- [Why use open-source software?](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open/why-use-reasons-for): Tutorial on open-source benefits including vendor lock-in avoidance and operational safety

## Licensing and Compliance

- [Open-source software licenses](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open/licenses): Comprehensive reference on open-source licenses, OSI compliance, and license obligations
- [The copyleft obligation](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open/the-copyleft-obligation): Technical reference on copyleft obligations and license compliance requirements
- [Intellectual property rights](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open/intellectual-property-rights): Reference guide to intellectual property rights in open-source software contexts
- [End-users and distributors](https://dirkriehle.com/open-source/software/free-and-open/end-users-and-distributors): Reference on license obligations for end-users and distributors of open-source software

## Open Source Strategy and Business

- [The Open Source Distributor Business Model](https://dirkriehle.com/publications/2021-selected/the-open-source-distributor-business-model): Article on commercial open source distributor model used by SUSE and Red Hat
- [Mit Open Source und Offenheit gewinnen](https://dirkriehle.com/publications/2023-selected/mit-open-source-und-offenheit-gewinnen): German article on open source strategy for business competition and market expansion
- [Open source definition](https://dirkriehle.com/publications/2023-selected/the-future-of-the-open-source-definition): Article on the future of open source definition and OSI criteria evolution
